historical_exceptions.reason: The preserved August native export contains 4111 CTCAE 6.0/PT rows, but its preserved configuration has no VSAB mapping and its source metadata has no corresponding definition. Preserve the archived producer behavior for this exact August input bundle; no mapping correction or operational release approval is claimed.

provenance.origin: Reviewed operational preparation metadata; this model does not recreate the historical metadata database
provenance.derivation: Name fields according to the loader contract and parameterize current/replacement suffixes. The catalog includes all known source/termgroup definitions. Default BLOODPAC rankings describe an established source; its explicit first-release plan replaces those rankings and emits its root records. Catalog membership does not assert that a root exists in NCImeta.

archived_release_review.basis: One observed August DICOM/SY native record. Preserved configuration maps DICOM; generic native SY branch supports the token, but preserved termgroups metadata has only DICOM/PT. Vocabulary addition records native observation only; no metadata correction or installation claim. Output validation and exact comparison remain mandatory.
